name: Graphify (Code & Knowledge Graph)
ai_instructions: To analyze and graph project dependencies, run 'python rigtools/graphify.py .'. This generates an interactive visual graph at 'graphify-out/graph.html', raw graph data at 'graphify-out/graph.json', and an architectural summary at 'graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md'. MANDATORY: Always inspect 'graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md' first before searching or reading multiple files to trace God Nodes and direct connections, cutting token usage.

claude_command.name: graphify
claude_command.content:
# /graphify

Generate and inspect the visual codebase dependency graph.

1. Run: `python rigtools/graphify.py .`
2. Review God Nodes and community hubs in graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md before making architectural changes.
